description: Na₂MnF₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.51 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. There are four shorter (1.86 Å) and two longer (2.12 Å) Mn-F bond lengths. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.11 Å. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mn atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Mn atoms to form distorted FNa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five FNa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramid. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramids. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mn atom.
